Detailed Description

Exception class that prints out cfitsio errors when thrown.

Has one constructor method prints out error message corresponding to the an integer return status [i.e. as returned by cfitsio]. Control is then returned to wherever the error was caught.

FitsError is a subclass of FitsException. It can be caught in a catch-all

catch (FitsException&)

clause, or separately by

catch (FitsError)
